meta.description: Stations on the first Phase II stretch of Chennai Metro Line 4 (Yellow Line), listed west to east from Poonamallee Bypass to Vadapalani.

coordinateQuality.station: Coordinates of the metro station itself, from its Wikipedia article.
coordinateQuality.bus-stop: Coordinates of the MTC bus stop of the same name (MTC GTFS feed via TellMyRoute). The station sits on the same road; treat as approximate (±150 m).
coordinateQuality.locality: Coordinates of the locality (Wikipedia). The station sits on the main road through it; treat as approximate (±300 m).
coordinateQuality.interpolated: No published coordinates. Placed on the straight line between Porur Junction and Vadapalani for visualisation only, spaced so Alapakkam–Alwarthirunagar spans the reported 3.75 km double-decker. Replace with surveyed data when available.

meta.tamilNames: Standard Tamil spellings of the locality names, cross-checked against Tamil-language news coverage of the opening (Oneindia Tamil, ETV Bharat Tamil). CMRL has not yet published official station signage spellings, so nameTaVerified is false until it does. Phase II stations without a Tamil name in OpenStreetMap take the spelling from the Tamil Wikipedia Chennai Metro Phase II route diagram (Template:Phase II, Chennai Metro, read 2026-10-11), with abbreviations expanded; each station note says which source it used.

sources.wiki-stations: Wikipedia articles for Poonamallee Bypass, Mullaithottam, Thelliyaragaram, Porur Bypass, Porur Junction and Vadapalani metro stations
sources.wiki-localities: Wikipedia articles for Kattupakkam, Iyyapanthangal and Kumananchavadi
sources.mtc-gtfs: MTC bus stops 'Poonamallee' and 'Karayanchavadi' (TellMyRoute, Chennai MTC GTFS)
sources.dtnext-cmrs: DT Next — 'Poonamallee Bypass-Porur Metro services to begin soon' (CMRS authorises 14.6 km Poonamallee Bypass–Porur Junction–Vadapalani)
sources.dtnext-fares: DT Next — 'Poonamallee-Vadapalani Metro fares fixed at Rs 10-Rs 40 ahead of proposed October 11 inauguration' (Sep 2026)
sources.nativeplanet-opening: NativePlanet — 'Chennai Metro Phase-2: Poonamallee to Vadapalani Stretch Opens October 11'
sources.jagran-double-decker: Daily Jagran / DT Next — Arcot Road double-decker: 3.75 km between Alapakkam and Alwarthirunagar, Corridor 4 on the lower deck
sources.railanalysis-skip: Rail Analysis India — trial run Porur Junction–Vadapalani; services skip Alapakkam, Karambakkam, Valasaravakkam, Alwarthirunagar, Virugambakkam South, Saligramam

stations.name: Porur Junction
